==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=FakeItEasy&min=FakeItEasy&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Plugins/FakeItEasyTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=FakeItEasy&min=FakeItEasy&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using FakeItEasy;

// Verify.FakeItEasy: Snapshots FakeItEasy fakes: the calls one received, their arguments, and its FakeManager.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.FakeItEasy
// Note: Purely a converter plugin: nothing is compared or converted to a file, only serialized
// more readably.
// Note: The snapshot has the same shape as Verify.NSubstitute's, so switching mocking library
// keeps the verified files close.
public class FakeItEasyTests
{
    // Verifying the recorded calls replaces a list of hand written asserts: the method, its
    // parameter names and the values passed all land in the snapshot.
    [Fact]
    public Task ReceivedCalls()
    {
        var target = A.Fake<ITarget>();
        target.Method(1, 2);
        var calls = Fake.GetCalls(target);
        return Verify(calls);
    }
}
